thread:
maya: FYI — Apogee's private VPC deploy is scheduled for Mon 2026-04-06 02:00-03:30 UTC. This is a small infra change (egress ACL + NAT update) + model bump on their dedicated nodes. Need volunteers for deploy lead, smoke, and rollback owner.

sam: I can be deploy lead. I'll be oncall that window.

adrian: I can do smoke tests and stay until +30m. What are the specific smoke checks?

maya: Thanks @sam @adrian. Smoke checklist (short):
- control plane health (api /models, /status)
- customer model load + inference at p50/p95 latencies
- KV cache sanity for long-chat sessions
- external connectivity: NAT egress to customer S3 endpoints

Commands for quick smoke (copy/paste):
```bash
# control plane
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDC_API_KEY" https://apogee-vpc.internal/models | jq .status
# model infer sanity
python -c "import requests;print(requests.post('https://apogee-vpc.internal/generate', json={'prompt':'hello'}, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer $REDC_API_KEY'}).status_code)"
```

ops-bot: Reminder: run the preflight checklist in /deploy/checklists/apogee.txt before starting.

tash: I can be rollback owner. I'll prepare the snapshot + routing pin.

leo: Two quick notes:
1) The NAT change will be done on the leaf routers at 02:10 UTC; expect a ~15s flow teardown for existing sessions.
2) There is a scheduled DB maintenance at 03:20 UTC in the same region (low risk), just flagging it.

priya: For rollbacks, are we doing DNS pinning or traffic-split? Also what model version is target?

maya: Traffic will be 100% flip (no weighted split) — we want deterministic rollback. Target model tag: `apogee-v2.3.1-quant`.

sam: Plan:
- 02:00 start, preflight docs checked (ops-bot)
- 02:05 apply infra change (egress ACL) in canary AZ
- 02:10 NAT update cluster-wide
- 02:15 model rollout to dedicated pool (canary node first)
- 02:25 smoke run by @adrian
- 02:40 approve full rollout or rollback by 02:45

adrian: On smoke: I'll validate 5 sample prompts, run a 60s load at 10 rps against canary, and check KV cache hit-rate. If p95 latency > 700ms or error rate > 1% we abort.

maya: If abort, @tash runs `rollback.sh apogee 20260305-snapshot` and pins traffic back to `apogee-v2.3.0`.

leo: I'll be monitoring infra metrics (netflow, NAT errors) and can rollback NAT config quickly if we see >0.5% connection failures.

priya: Added one verification: confirm audit logs & KMS access post-change (customer needs logs for compliance).

sam: Got it. I'll create a short runbook and paste it into the incident channel at T-15.

maya: Anything else? If not, I'll mark the calendar and send the quiet-window notice to the customer. :white_check_mark:

leo: All good from infra side. :thumbsup:

adrian: I'll be present. saving the commands.

ops-bot: Preflight check complete? status: pending. Run `/deploy preflight apogee` when ready.

maya: I'll run it at 01:40 UTC and report back in this thread.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll post the runbook link here once created.

maya: (01:42 UTC) Preflight passed with minor warning on ephemeral port range — documented and safe. Marking ready.
